tools.name: get_relevant_contacts
tools.description: Retrieves contact info for classmates, faculty, HOD, or subject teachers via ContactsRepo interface.

tools.name: create_chat_group
tools.description: Creates a temporary or permanent group in the local chat_groups/group_members operational tables.

tools.name: draft_official_email
tools.description: Formats an official email using student profile context. Returns draft + requires_user_approval: true. Never sends directly.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email using Gmail API upon human approval.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: Schedules an appointment using Google Calendar API.

tools.name: update_appointment
tools.description: Updates an existing appointment in Google Calendar.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancels an existing appointment in Google Calendar.

tools.name: schedule_reminder
tools.description: Schedules a reminder for campus events or tasks.

tools.name: get_github_profile
tools.description: Retrieves GitHub profile info (repos, contributions, languages) via GitHub API.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Finds eligible job/internship opportunities matching student profile via Jobs API.

tools.name: get_all_eligible_companies
tools.description: Retrieves all eligible placement companies based on CGPA and backlog criteria.

tools.name: create_study_plan
tools.description: Generates a study plan for an upcoming exam and materializes it into Todoist tasks + Google Calendar events.

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Gets routing/directions using Google Maps API supplementing on-campus dataset.

tools.name: find_nearby_facilities
tools.description: Finds nearby facilities using Google Maps API.

tools.name: add_event_to_calendar
tools.description: Adds a registered campus event to Google Calendar.
